title_zh: 根据咨询来源调整课程广告渠道

scenario.label_zh: 调整社区课程宣传方式
scenario.goal_zh: 核对报名咨询来源并选择下一期课程的广告渠道

context_zh: 宣传顾问与课程负责人比较上期咨询来源，为新一期课程选择广告投放渠道。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: The client wants a newspaper ad for the next course. Do we know whether the last one worked?

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: We asked each caller where they heard about us. Two mentioned the newspaper, and eighteen mentioned the local newsletter.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Were those all new enquiries, rather than people already on the course?

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Yes. We recorded returning students separately.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Then the newsletter looks like the better channel. How much space can we buy with the same budget?

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: A half-page notice, twice during the month.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Let us propose that instead, with a phone number we can track.

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Agreed. I will send the client the figures and the newsletter option this afternoon.
